q: 我以前在海南住___，那里冬天也很热。
zh: 我以前在海南住过，那里冬天也很热。
py: wǒ yǐ qián zài hǎi nán zhù guo nà lǐ dōng tiān yě hěn rè
en: I used to live in Hainan; it's hot there even in winter.
why: 以前 plus a place I know first-hand is an experience that is over: 过. 着 would mean I still live there, and 住了 would need a length of time or a result to be complete.

q: 这种雨衣我穿___，一点儿也不防水。
zh: 这种雨衣我穿过，一点儿也不防水。
py: zhè zhǒng yǔ yī wǒ chuān guo yī diǎn r yě bù fáng shuǐ
en: I've worn this kind of raincoat; it isn't waterproof at all.
why: "I have tried it, so I know" is experience, and 过 sits right after the verb. 着 would describe wearing it right now, which cannot support a verdict from past use.

q: 他以前开___出租车，现在在银行工作。
zh: 他以前开过出租车，现在在银行工作。
py: tā yǐ qián kāi guo chū zū chē xiàn zài zài yín háng gōng zuò
en: He used to drive a taxi; now he works at a bank.
why: A job he did before and no longer does is experience: 开过. 着 would mean he is driving now, which clashes with 现在在银行工作.

q: 这种天气预报软件我以前用___，后来发现不太准，就不用了。
zh: 这种天气预报软件我以前用过，后来发现不太准，就不用了。
py: zhè zhǒng tiān qì yù bào ruǎn jiàn wǒ yǐ qián yòng guo hòu lái fā xiàn bù tài zhǔn jiù bù yòng le
en: I used to use this kind of weather app, but I found it not very accurate and stopped.
why: 以前…后来… describes a stretch of use that is finished, so 过 after 用. 着 would mean I am still using it, which the last clause denies.

q: 同学说小李以前当___班长，所以很会管人。
zh: 同学说小李以前当过班长，所以很会管人。
py: tóng xué shuō xiǎo lǐ yǐ qián dāng guo bān zhǎng suǒ yǐ hěn huì guǎn rén
en: A classmate says Xiao Li used to be class monitor, so he is good at managing people.
why: 以前 plus a role he no longer holds is experience: 当过. 当着 would mean he is monitor now, which 以前 rules out.

q: 下这么大的雨我也遇到___，别担心。
zh: 下这么大的雨我也遇到过，别担心。
py: xià zhè me dà de yǔ wǒ yě yù dào guo bié dān xīn
en: I've been through rain this heavy too, so don't worry.
why: "I have been through it, so do not worry" is experience: 遇到过. 着 would mean running into it right now, which would not reassure anyone.

q: 小时候我们在这条河里游___泳，现在河水太脏了。
zh: 小时候我们在这条河里游过泳，现在河水太脏了。
py: xiǎo shí hou wǒ men zài zhè tiáo hé lǐ yóu guo yǒng xiàn zài hé shuǐ tài zāng le
en: As children we swam in this river; now the water is too dirty.
why: 游泳 is verb + object, so 过 goes inside it: 游过泳. 小时候 with a contrast to now marks a finished past experience, which 了 or 着 would not give.

q: 我和小王以前见___面，所以一眼就认出他了。
zh: 我和小王以前见过面，所以一眼就认出他了。
py: wǒ hé xiǎo wáng yǐ qián jiàn guo miàn suǒ yǐ yī yǎn jiù rèn chū tā le
en: Xiao Wang and I have met before, so I recognised him at a glance.
why: 见面 is verb + object, so 过 goes after 见. Having met before explains the recognition; 着 would mean the meeting is going on now.

q: 我以前去那儿吃___饭，菜很好吃，就是有点儿贵。
zh: 我以前去那儿吃过饭，菜很好吃，就是有点儿贵。
py: wǒ yǐ qián qù nà r chī guo fàn cài hěn hǎo chī jiù shì yǒu diǎn r guì
en: I've eaten there before; the food is good, just a bit pricey.
why: With 去那儿 before another verb, 过 goes on the action verb 吃: 吃过饭. 了 would report a single meal and could not support a general verdict on the restaurant.

q: 我们以前在大雨里跑___步，那种感觉很特别。
zh: 我们以前在大雨里跑过步，那种感觉很特别。
py: wǒ men yǐ qián zài dà yǔ lǐ pǎo guo bù nà zhǒng gǎn jué hěn tè bié
en: We once ran in heavy rain; it felt special.
why: 跑步 is verb + object, so 过 goes inside it: 跑过步. 以前 plus a remembered feeling is experience; 着 would describe running in progress.

q: 我以前在山上看___雪，太美了，我还想再看一次。
zh: 我以前在山上看过雪，太美了，我还想再看一次。
py: wǒ yǐ qián zài shān shàng kàn guo xuě tài měi le wǒ hái xiǎng zài kàn yī cì
en: I have seen snow in the mountains before; it was so beautiful that I want to see it again.
why: 过 goes right after 看, before the object 雪. 还想再看 shows a past experience the speaker wants to repeat; 着 would mean looking at snow right now.

q: 我在国外留___学，所以不怕一个人生活。
zh: 我在国外留过学，所以不怕一个人生活。
py: wǒ zài guó wài liú guo xué suǒ yǐ bù pà yī ge rén shēng huó
en: I have studied abroad, so I'm not afraid of living alone.
why: 留学 is verb + object, so 过 goes in the middle: 留过学. The period abroad is over and explains the confidence; 着 would mean I am still studying abroad.

q: 我还没看___雪呢，真想去北方。
zh: 我还没看过雪呢，真想去北方。
py: wǒ hái méi kàn guo xuě ne zhēn xiǎng qù běi fāng
en: I haven't seen snow yet; I really want to go north.
why: 还没 + verb + 过 means "have not yet experienced it". 了 can never follow 没 here, and 的 and 得 are not aspect markers.

q: 我___去过哈尔滨，不知道那里多冷。
zh: 我没去过哈尔滨，不知道那里多冷。
py: wǒ méi qù guo hā ěr bīn bù zhī dào nà lǐ duō lěng
en: I've never been to Harbin, so I don't know how cold it gets.
why: The negative of 过 is 没: 没去过. 不去过 does not exist, and 别 is a command.

q: 我们俩还没一起旅行___，周末先去爬山吧。
zh: 我们俩还没一起旅行过，周末先去爬山吧。
py: wǒ men liǎ hái méi yī qǐ lǚ xíng guo zhōu mò xiān qù pá shān ba
en: The two of us haven't travelled together yet, so let's start with a hike this weekend.
why: 还没…过 says the experience has not happened yet. 了 cannot follow 没, and 着 does not fit "never done".

q: 朋友说这家店不错，可惜我一直没去___。
zh: 朋友说这家店不错，可惜我一直没去过。
py: péng you shuō zhè jiā diàn bù cuò kě xī wǒ yī zhí méi qù guo
en: A friend says this shop is good; too bad I've never been.
why: 一直没 + verb + 过 means "never so far". 没去了 is impossible, and 没去着 would mean trying to go and failing once.

q: 我没有参加___他们的聚会，不知道谁会来。
zh: 我没有参加过他们的聚会，不知道谁会来。
py: wǒ méi yǒu cān jiā guo tā men de jù huì bù zhī dào shéi huì lái
en: I've never been to any of their gatherings, so I don't know who comes.
why: 没有 + verb + 过 says "never so far". 了 cannot follow 没有, and 着 does not suit a one-off event.

q: 因为天气一直不好，我们到现在还没去___那个湖。
zh: 因为天气一直不好，我们到现在还没去过那个湖。
py: yīn wèi tiān qì yī zhí bù hǎo wǒ men dào xiàn zài hái méi qù guo nà ge hú
en: Because the weather has stayed bad, we still haven't been to that lake.
why: 到现在还没 asks for "not yet, ever": 没去过. 了 after 没 is ungrammatical, and 着 would not mean "not yet been".

q: 我从小怕冷，没有滑___雪，也没有溜过冰。
zh: 我从小怕冷，没有滑过雪，也没有溜过冰。
py: wǒ cóng xiǎo pà lěng méi yǒu huá guo xuě yě méi yǒu liū guo bīng
en: I've feared the cold since childhood, so I've never skied or skated.
why: Two parallel negatives: 没有 + verb + 过 for "never". 了 and 着 cannot follow 没有 in this meaning.

q: 他现在不在家，他去___上海。
zh: 他现在不在家，他去了上海。
py: tā xiàn zài bù zài jiā tā qù le shàng hǎi
en: He is not home now; he has gone to Shanghai.
why: He left and is still away, so the trip is a completed event whose result holds now: 了. 过 would mean he went and has already come back.

q: 小王昨天搬___家，今天很累。
zh: 小王昨天搬了家，今天很累。
py: xiǎo wáng zuó tiān bān le jiā jīn tiān hěn lèi
en: Xiao Wang moved house yesterday and is tired today.
why: 昨天 plus a result that still holds today (tired) is one specific event: 了. 过 would mean he has moved house at some time in his life.

q: 我小时候去___上海，所以知道那里的冬天很冷。
zh: 我小时候去过上海，所以知道那里的冬天很冷。
py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou qù guo shàng hǎi suǒ yǐ zhī dào nà lǐ de dōng tiān hěn lěng
en: I went to Shanghai as a child, so I know its winters are cold.
why: 小时候 plus "so I know" cites what a past trip taught me: 过. 了 would only report one trip, and 着 does not fit a trip.

q: 昨天雪很大，我们堆___三个雪人。
zh: 昨天雪很大，我们堆了三个雪人。
py: zuó tiān xuě hěn dà wǒ men duī le sān ge xuě rén
en: It snowed hard yesterday and we built three snowmen.
why: 昨天 plus a counted object is one specific event: 了 right after the verb. 过 would mean "have built three before", which does not fit a stated day.

q: 她上星期买___一把新雨伞，还没用过呢。
zh: 她上星期买了一把新雨伞，还没用过呢。
py: tā shàng xīng qī mǎi le yī bǎ xīn yǔ sǎn hái méi yòng guo ne
en: She bought a new umbrella last week and hasn't used it yet.
why: 上星期 plus a counted object is one specific purchase: 了. 过 would say she has bought umbrellas in general, not this one.

q: 这家店我以前来___，所以知道哪个菜好吃。
zh: 这家店我以前来过，所以知道哪个菜好吃。
py: zhè jiā diàn wǒ yǐ qián lái guo suǒ yǐ zhī dào nǎ ge cài hǎo chī
en: I've been to this restaurant before, so I know which dishes are good.
why: 以前来 plus "so I know" cites what experience taught me: 过. 了 would only report one visit and could not explain the knowledge.

q: 昨天晚上我们看___一场电影，十一点才回家。
zh: 昨天晚上我们看了一场电影，十一点才回家。
py: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ men kàn le yī chǎng diàn yǐng shí yī diǎn cái huí jiā
en: Last night we saw a film and didn't get home until eleven.
why: 昨天晚上 plus a counted object and a time of return narrates one event: 了. 过 would mean "have seen a film before", which cannot tell what happened last night.

q: 听说小王和小李昨天终于见___面，还一起吃了晚饭。
zh: 听说小王和小李昨天终于见了面，还一起吃了晚饭。
py: tīng shuō xiǎo wáng hé xiǎo lǐ zuó tiān zhōng yú jiàn le miàn hái yī qǐ chī le wǎn fàn
en: I hear Xiao Wang and Xiao Li finally met yesterday and had dinner together.
why: 昨天 plus 终于 and a chain of events (met, then ate) is narration, so 了 goes after 见. 过 says "have met before", which clashes with 终于 and 昨天.

q: 他昨天遇到___一场大雪，路上走了三个小时。
zh: 他昨天遇到了一场大雪，路上走了三个小时。
py: tā zuó tiān yù dào le yī chǎng dà xuě lù shàng zǒu le sān ge xiǎo shí
en: Yesterday he ran into a heavy snowfall and spent three hours on the road.
why: 昨天 and "took three hours" tell what happened on one day: 了. 过 would say he has experienced heavy snow at some time, and cannot carry the consequence.

q: 这个季节的杭州我以前去___，雨多，人也多，这次想换个地方。
zh: 这个季节的杭州我以前去过，雨多，人也多，这次想换个地方。
py: zhè ge jì jié de háng zhōu wǒ yǐ qián qù guo yǔ duō rén yě duō zhè cì xiǎng huàn ge dì fang
en: I've been to Hangzhou at this time of year before: lots of rain and lots of people, so this time I want somewhere else.
why: A fronted topic, 以前 and a verdict drawn from what I know: 去过. 了 would report one completed trip and would not justify choosing elsewhere.

q: 我去过两___北京，冬天的北京特别冷。
zh: 我去过两次北京，冬天的北京特别冷。
py: wǒ qù guo liǎng cì běi jīng dōng tiān de běi jīng tè bié lěng
en: I've been to Beijing twice; Beijing in winter is especially cold.
why: 次 counts occasions of going. 遍 means a whole run-through (reading, watching), and 个 is not the counter for trips.

q: 我见过他三___，每次都是下雨天。
zh: 我见过他三次，每次都是下雨天。
py: wǒ jiàn guo tā sān cì měi cì dōu shì xià yǔ tiān
en: I've met him three times, and it was a rainy day every time.
why: 次 counts meetings, and the pronoun 他 comes before the count. 遍 is for going through something from start to finish, not for meeting a person.

q: 这个星期我找过他___，他都不在。
zh: 这个星期我找过他三次，他都不在。
py: zhè ge xīng qī wǒ zhǎo guo tā sān cì tā dōu bù zài
en: I looked for him three times this week and he was out each time.
why: 次 counts occasions of looking for someone, and a pronoun object goes before the count. 遍 is for full run-throughs, and 个 and 点 are not counters for attempts.

q: 老师说过很多___，可是我还是记不住。
zh: 老师说过很多遍，可是我还是记不住。
py: lǎo shī shuō guo hěn duō biàn kě shì wǒ hái shì jì bù zhù
en: The teacher has said it many times, but I still cannot remember.
why: 遍 counts repetitions of saying something through; 个, 年 and 把 do not count repetitions of speaking.

q: 你去过几___北京？
zh: 你去过几次北京？
py: nǐ qù guo jǐ cì běi jīng
en: How many times have you been to Beijing?
why: 几次 asks how many occasions. 遍 is for whole run-throughs, and 个 and 年 do not count visits.

q: 这个故事奶奶给我讲过无数___，我都能背下来了。
zh: 这个故事奶奶给我讲过无数遍，我都能背下来了。
py: zhè ge gù shi nǎi nai gěi wǒ jiǎng guo wú shù biàn wǒ dōu néng bèi xià lái le
en: Grandma has told me this story countless times; I can recite it.
why: 遍 fits telling a story through from start to finish. 个, 年 and 本 are not counters for repetitions.

q: 这个地方我们下雨天来过___，所以路很熟。
zh: 这个地方我们下雨天来过很多次，所以路很熟。
py: zhè ge dì fang wǒ men xià yǔ tiān lái guo hěn duō cì suǒ yǐ lù hěn shú
en: We've come to this place on rainy days many times, so we know the road well.
why: 次 counts occasions of coming. 遍 is for run-throughs of a text or film, and 个 and 步 do not count visits.

q: 你吃饭了吗？吃___了，谢谢。
zh: 你吃饭了吗？吃过了，谢谢。
py: nǐ chī fàn le ma chī guo le xiè xie
en: Have you eaten? Yes, I already have, thanks.
why: V过了 reports a routine thing as already done. 着 would mean you are eating at this moment, and 的 and 得 are not aspect markers.

q: 你吃___药了吗？没吃的话现在就吃。
zh: 你吃过药了吗？没吃的话现在就吃。
py: nǐ chī guo yào le ma méi chī de huà xiàn zài jiù chī
en: Have you taken your medicine yet? If not, take it now.
why: Asking whether a routine thing is already done: 吃过药了吗. 着 would ask whether you are in the middle of taking it.

q: 晚上一起吃饭吗？不了，我已经吃___了。
zh: 晚上一起吃饭吗？不了，我已经吃过了。
py: wǎn shang yī qǐ chī fàn ma bù le wǒ yǐ jīng chī guo le
en: Dinner together tonight? No thanks, I've already eaten.
why: 已经 + V过…了 says a routine thing is already done. 着 would mean "am eating right now", which does not decline the invitation.

q: 天气预报我已经看___了，明天不会下雨。
zh: 天气预报我已经看过了，明天不会下雨。
py: tiān qì yù bào wǒ yǐ jīng kàn guo le míng tiān bù huì xià yǔ
en: I've already checked the weather forecast; it won't rain tomorrow.
why: With the object fronted, 看过了 means "already checked". 着 would be "checking right now", which cannot report what the forecast says.

q: 你问___老师了吗？他说周末不会下雨。
zh: 你问过老师了吗？他说周末不会下雨。
py: nǐ wèn guo lǎo shī le ma tā shuō zhōu mò bù huì xià yǔ
en: Have you asked the teacher yet? He says it won't rain this weekend.
why: 问过…了吗 asks whether a to-do is already done. 着 would mean asking in progress, and 的 and 得 are not aspect markers.

q: 你检查___行李了吗？___检查呢，等一下。
zh: 你检查过行李了吗？还没检查呢，等一下。
py: nǐ jiǎn chá guo xíng li le ma hái méi jiǎn chá ne děng yī xià
en: Have you checked the luggage yet? Not yet, wait a moment.
why: 检查过…了吗 asks whether it is already done, and the answer is 还没检查呢, dropping 过 and 了. 着 means in progress, and 还没过 and 不 are not how "not yet" is said.

q: 咖啡我已经喝___了，不用再给我了。
zh: 咖啡我已经喝过了，不用再给我了。
py: kā fēi wǒ yǐ jīng hē guo le bù yòng zài gěi wǒ le
en: I've already had coffee; no need to give me more.
why: 已经 + V过了 means the routine thing is already done, which is why more is not needed. 着 would mean I am drinking it now.

q: 你有___有去过长城？
zh: 你有没有去过长城？
py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu qù guo cháng chéng
en: Have you ever been to the Great Wall?
why: 有没有 is the A-not-A form of 有 and its negative is 没. 有不有 is never said, and 吗 cannot sit in the middle.

q: 你吃过饺子___？我可以教你包。
zh: 你吃过饺子没有？我可以教你包。
py: nǐ chī guo jiǎo zi méi yǒu wǒ kě yǐ jiāo nǐ bāo
en: Have you ever had dumplings? I can teach you to make them.
why: A question on 过 can end with 没有: 吃过…没有. 不 cannot negate 过, and 吗 is not added to 没有.

q: 你去过哈尔滨吗？___，去年冬天去过两次。
zh: 你去过哈尔滨吗？去过，去年冬天去过两次。
py: nǐ qù guo hā ěr bīn ma qù guo qù nián dōng tiān qù guo liǎng cì
en: Have you ever been to Harbin? Yes, I went twice last winter.
why: A yes answer repeats the verb with 过. 去了 would report one trip, and 去的 and 去着 are not answers.

q: 你们去过那个海边___？没去过的话，周末一起去吧。
zh: 你们去过那个海边吗？没去过的话，周末一起去吧。
py: nǐ men qù guo nà ge hǎi biān ma méi qù guo de huà zhōu mò yī qǐ qù ba
en: Have you been to that seaside? If not, let us go together this weekend.
why: A plain yes/no question on 过 takes 吗 at the end. 不 is not the question form, and 没有 and 吗 are never stacked.

q: 你以前去___去过那个湖？听说秋天特别美。
zh: 你以前去没去过那个湖？听说秋天特别美。
py: nǐ yǐ qián qù méi qù guo nà ge hú tīng shuō qiū tiān tè bié měi
en: Have you been to that lake before? I hear it's especially beautiful in autumn.
why: The A-not-A form of a 过 question uses 没: 去没去过. 去不去过 is wrong because 过 is never negated with 不.

q: 你听过这首歌吗？___，这是我第一次听。
zh: 你听过这首歌吗？没听过，这是我第一次听。
py: nǐ tīng guo zhè shǒu gē ma méi tīng guo zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì tīng
en: Have you heard this song? No, this is my first time.
why: The negative answer is 没 + verb + 过. 听了 says I did listen, 不听过 uses 不 with 过, and 听着 means listening now.

q: 我从来___去过那里，不知道天气怎么样。
zh: 我从来没去过那里，不知道天气怎么样。
py: wǒ cóng lái méi qù guo nà lǐ bù zhī dào tiān qì zěn me yàng
en: I've never been there, so I don't know what the weather is like.
why: 从来 + 没 + verb + 过 means "never once". 不 cannot go with 过, 别 is a command, and 未 is literary.

q: 他从来没迟到___，今天真奇怪。
zh: 他从来没迟到过，今天真奇怪。
py: tā cóng lái méi chí dào guo jīn tiān zhēn qí guài
en: He has never been late; today is strange.
why: 从来没…过 keeps 过 and takes no 了. 了 after 没 is impossible, and 着 would change the meaning to a state in progress.

q: 我从来没见___这么冷的天气。
zh: 我从来没见过这么冷的天气。
py: wǒ cóng lái méi jiàn guo zhè me lěng de tiān qì
en: I have never seen weather this cold.
why: 从来没见过这么… is the fixed frame for "never seen such a …". 了 cannot follow 没, and 着 does not belong here.

q: 我从来___喝咖啡，晚上会睡不着。
zh: 我从来不喝咖啡，晚上会睡不着。
py: wǒ cóng lái bù hē kā fēi wǎn shang huì shuì bù zháo
en: I never drink coffee; I wouldn't be able to sleep at night.
why: A habit with no 过 in the sentence takes 从来不. 从来没 and 从来没有 would need 过 after the verb.

q: 我们认识十年了，他从来___对我发过脾气。
zh: 我们认识十年了，他从来没对我发过脾气。
py: wǒ men rèn shi shí nián le tā cóng lái méi duì wǒ fā guo pí qi
en: We have known each other ten years and he has never lost his temper with me.
why: 发过 already carries 过, so the negative is 没: 从来没…发过. 从来不…过 is impossible, and 从来 goes before 没.

q: 虽然天气一直很冷，可是他___没感冒过。
zh: 虽然天气一直很冷，可是他从来没感冒过。
py: suī rán tiān qì yī zhí hěn lěng kě shì tā cóng lái méi gǎn mào guo
en: Even though it has been cold all along, he has never caught a cold.
why: "Never once" is 从来 + 没 + verb + 过. 总是 and 经常 mean always and often, and 马上 means right away; none of them pairs with 没…过 this way.

zh: 我在海边游过泳。
py: wǒ zài hǎi biān yóu guo yǒng
en: I have swum at the beach.
why: 游泳 is verb + object, so 过 splits it. 在海边 stays before the verb, and 过 cannot follow 泳.

zh: 她以前结过婚。
py: tā yǐ qián jié guo hūn
en: She has been married before.
why: 结婚 is verb + object, so 过 goes between: 结过婚. 以前 may stand before or after 她, but 过 cannot move to the end.

zh: 我去那家店吃过饭。
py: wǒ qù nà jiā diàn chī guo fàn
en: I've eaten at that restaurant.
why: When 去 + place comes before another verb, 过 goes on the action verb 吃, inside 吃饭. 过 does not move onto 去.

zh: 我还没爬过那座山。
py: wǒ hái méi pá guo nà zuò shān
en: I haven't climbed that mountain yet.
why: 还 comes before 没, and 没 comes before the verb + 过. 过 cannot be dropped and 了 cannot be added.

zh: 我们还没一起滑过雪。
py: wǒ men hái méi yī qǐ huá guo xuě
en: We haven't skied together yet.
why: 还没 precedes 一起 and the verb; 过 stays on 滑 and the object 雪 follows. 没 cannot be moved after the verb.

zh: 我见过他两次。
py: wǒ jiàn guo tā liǎng cì
en: I have met him twice.
why: A pronoun object goes before the count: 见过他两次. 两次他 is not possible.

zh: 我去过两次厦门。
py: wǒ qù guo liǎng cì xià mén
en: I've been to Xiamen twice.
why: 过 comes straight after the verb. With a place name the count may come before or after it, but never before 过.

zh: 这首歌我听过很多遍。
py: zhè shǒu gē wǒ tīng guo hěn duō biàn
en: I've listened to this song many times.
why: The object is fronted as a topic, and the count 遍 follows 听过. 遍 cannot come before the verb.

zh: 你骑过马没有？
py: nǐ qí guo mǎ méi yǒu
en: Have you ever ridden a horse?
why: Ask the experience question by adding 没有 at the end. 过 stays after 骑, and 不 cannot be used.

zh: 你有没有在雪地里玩过？
py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu zài xuě dì lǐ wán guo
en: Have you ever played in the snow?
why: 有没有 goes before the verb phrase and 过 stays on the verb. 吗 is not added to a 有没有 question.

zh: 你去过几次那个地方？
py: nǐ qù guo jǐ cì nà ge dì fang
en: How many times have you been to that place?
why: 几次 asks how many times and follows 过; with a place object it may come before or after the place. It cannot go before 过.

zh: 我从来没见过这么冷的冬天。
py: wǒ cóng lái méi jiàn guo zhè me lěng de dōng tiān
en: I have never seen such a cold winter.
why: 从来 comes before 没, then the verb with 过. The object 这么冷的冬天 may be fronted as a topic, but 从来 never follows 没.

zh: 他从来不喝冰水。
py: tā cóng lái bù hē bīng shuǐ
en: He never drinks iced water.
why: A habit takes 从来不 + verb with no 过. 从来 stands before 不.

zh: 我已经吃过饭了。
py: wǒ yǐ jīng chī guo fàn le
en: I have already eaten.
why: 已经 comes before the verb; 过 goes after it and 了 closes the sentence to say the routine thing is already done.

zh: 他去了青岛，下星期才回来。
py: tā qù le qīng dǎo xià xīng qī cái huí lái
en: He has gone to Qingdao and won't be back until next week.
why: He is still away, so the trip is a completed event with a result that holds: 去了, not 去过. 才 comes right before 回来.

src_py: wǒ qù guo běi hǎi dào
task: Make it negative: you have never been.
zh: 我没去过北海道。
py: wǒ méi qù guo běi hǎi dào
en: I have never been to Hokkaido.
why: The negative of 过 is 没 before the verb, and 过 stays. 不 and 了 are not possible.

task: Say she has not done it yet.
zh: 她还没学过滑冰。
py: tā hái méi xué guo huá bīng
en: She hasn't taken skating lessons yet.
why: "Not yet" is 还没 + verb + 过. 还 stands before 没 and 过 is kept.

task: Turn it into a yes/no question with 吗.
zh: 你见过大雪吗？
py: nǐ jiàn guo dà xuě ma
en: Have you ever seen heavy snow?
why: A yes/no question on 过 just adds 吗 at the end. 过 stays and the verb is not negated.

src_py: nǐ kàn guo zhè ge diàn yǐng
task: Ask with 没有 at the end.
zh: 你看过这个电影没有？
py: nǐ kàn guo zhè ge diàn yǐng méi yǒu
en: Have you ever seen this film?
why: The 没有 question keeps 过 after the verb and puts 没有 at the end. 不 cannot form this question.

task: Say you have been twice, with the number after 过.
zh: 我去过两次西安。
py: wǒ qù guo liǎng cì xī ān
en: I've been to Xi'an twice.
why: 过 follows the verb and the count follows 过. A place name may come before or after the count.

src_py: tā kàn guo zhè běn shū
task: Say he has read it twice all the way through, object first.
zh: 这本书他看过两遍。
py: zhè běn shū tā kàn guo liǎng biàn
en: He has read this book twice through.
why: 遍 counts a full run-through of a book. The object is fronted as a topic and 两遍 follows 看过.

task: Say it was already done: add 已经 and 过, object first.
zh: 药他已经吃过了。
py: yào tā yǐ jīng chī guo le
en: He has already taken his medicine.
why: V过了 reports a routine thing as already done. 已经 goes before the verb and 了 closes the sentence.

src_py: wǒ jiàn guo zhè me dà de yǔ
task: Say you have never seen it.
zh: 我从来没见过这么大的雨。
py: wǒ cóng lái méi jiàn guo zhè me dà de yǔ
en: I have never seen rain this heavy.
why: 从来没…过 means "never once" and keeps 过. 从来 stands before 没, and 不 or 了 cannot replace it.

src_py: tā mǎi guo yī bǎ xīn sǎn
task: Say he bought it yesterday, as one specific event.
zh: 他昨天买了一把新伞。
py: tā zuó tiān mǎi le yī bǎ xīn sǎn
en: He bought a new umbrella yesterday.
why: A named day and a counted object make one specific event, so 了 replaces 过.

task: Say "we have met before" with 以前 and 过.
zh: 我们以前见过面。
py: wǒ men yǐ qián jiàn guo miàn
en: We have met before.
why: 见面 is verb + object, so 过 goes between 见 and 面. It cannot be placed after 面.

s_py: wǒ bù qù guo qīng dǎo
zh: 我没去过青岛。
py: wǒ méi qù guo qīng dǎo
en: I have never been to Qingdao.

s_py: wǒ men zài xuě tiān jiàn miàn guo

s_py: wǒ qù sān cì guo chéng dū
zh: 我去过三次成都。
py: wǒ qù guo sān cì chéng dū
en: I've been to Chengdu three times.

s_py: wǒ jiàn guo liǎng cì tā
zh: 我见过她两次。
py: wǒ jiàn guo tā liǎng cì
en: I have met her twice.

s_py: nǐ chī bù chī guo huǒ guō

py: nǐ chī méi chī guo huǒ guō
en: Have you ever had hotpot?

s_py: nǐ kàn guo méi yǒu zhè běn shū
zh: 你看过这本书没有？
py: nǐ kàn guo zhè běn shū méi yǒu
en: Have you read this book?
why: 没有 closes the question, after the object: 看过这本书没有. It cannot sit between 过 and the object.

s_py: wǒ cóng lái bù hē guo bīng shuǐ
zh: 我从来没喝过冰水。
py: wǒ cóng lái méi hē guo bīng shuǐ
en: I've never drunk iced water.
why: With 过 the negative must be 没. 从来不 exists only without 过, for a habit.

s_py: yào wǒ hái méi chī guo le

py: yào wǒ hái méi chī ne
en: I haven't taken the medicine yet.

s: 他去过广州，下个月才回来。

s_py: wǒ méi qù guo hǎi biān le

py: wǒ méi qù guo hǎi biān
en: I have never been to the seaside.

s: 我在冬天的北方待过两个星期。
s_py: wǒ zài dōng tiān de běi fāng dāi guo liǎng ge xīng qī

py: wǒ zài dōng tiān de běi fāng dāi guo liǎng ge xīng qī
en: I spent two weeks in the north in winter.
why: 过 can go with a stated duration; it still marks a stay that is over and now counts as experience.

s: 我小时候在河上滑过冰。
s_py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou zài hé shàng huá guo bīng
zh: 我小时候在河上滑过冰。
py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou zài hé shàng huá guo bīng
en: I skated on the river as a child.
why: 滑冰 is verb + object so 过 sits inside it, and 小时候 marks an experience that is over.

s: 朋友生了病，所以今天的聚会她来不了。
s_py: péng you shēng le bìng suǒ yǐ jīn tiān de jù huì tā lái bù liǎo
zh: 朋友生了病，所以今天的聚会她来不了。
py: péng you shēng le bìng suǒ yǐ jīn tiān de jù huì tā lái bù liǎo
en: My friend is ill, so she can't come to today's gathering.
why: The illness is a specific event whose result still holds today: 了. 过 would only say she has been ill at some time and would not explain her absence.

s: 这个故事我听过很多遍，可是还想再听。
s_py: zhè ge gù shi wǒ tīng guo hěn duō biàn kě shì hái xiǎng zài tīng
zh: 这个故事我听过很多遍，可是还想再听。
py: zhè ge gù shi wǒ tīng guo hěn duō biàn kě shì hái xiǎng zài tīng
en: I've heard this story many times, but I still want to hear it again.

s_py: nǐ xǐ guo zǎo le ma
zh: 你洗过澡了吗？
py: nǐ xǐ guo zǎo le ma
en: Have you had your shower yet?
why: V过…了吗 asks whether a routine thing is already done; 过 sits inside 洗澡. It is not about life experience.

s_py: nǐ xué guo yóu yǒng méi yǒu

py: nǐ xué guo yóu yǒng méi yǒu
en: Have you ever learned to swim?
why: 过 sits inside 游泳 and 没有 closes an experience question. This is the normal 没有 form.

s: 他从来不吃辣，所以从来没吃过火锅。
s_py: tā cóng lái bù chī là suǒ yǐ cóng lái méi chī guo huǒ guō
zh: 他从来不吃辣，所以从来没吃过火锅。
py: tā cóng lái bù chī là suǒ yǐ cóng lái méi chī guo huǒ guō
en: He never eats spicy food, so he has never had hotpot.
why: The habit is 从来不吃, with no 过; the experience is 从来没吃过, with 过. Each negative matches its meaning.

s: 我在冬天的海边散过步。
s_py: wǒ zài dōng tiān de hǎi biān sàn guo bù

en: I have taken walks by the sea in winter.
why: 散步 is verb + object, so 过 goes inside it: 散过步. The place phrase stays before the verb.

s: 我去年夏天去过一次大连。

zh: 我去年夏天去过一次大连。

en: I went to Dalian once last summer.

s_py: tā cóng lái méi yǒu piàn guo wǒ

py: tā cóng lái méi yǒu piàn guo wǒ
en: He has never lied to me.
